purpose: After closing existing backend reuse, source-only overlap, and layout-only residency, identify what compute+source candidate remains before changing runtime source.

closed_before_source_edit.name: existing Q8_1 one-stream up/down reuse
closed_before_source_edit.reason: Fails token-level top1 and full-output correctness in previously tested up/down classes; also worsens cache/source behavior.

closed_before_source_edit.name: naive/scalar MXFP4 x Q8_0 CUDA one-stream
closed_before_source_edit.reason: Historical probe reached only same_top1=136/145 with first mismatch at position 4; compare path timed out around 7 minutes, far beyond the 1.642887 s overhead budget.

closed_before_source_edit.name: source-only overlap
closed_before_source_edit.reason: Perfect source/page hiding has only an 8.993 tok/s zero-overhead ceiling.

closed_before_source_edit.name: layout-only exact compact residency
closed_before_source_edit.reason: Requires about 18.692 GiB of exact up/down resident payload before gate cache/workspace, which violates current RAM/VRAM constraints.

closed_before_source_edit.name: existing backend switch or io_uring-only path
closed_before_source_edit.reason: Current build has only CUDA/CPU active, batch/io_uring is disabled and IO-only, and Blackwell native FP4 is approximate/not wired into accepted one-stream.

still_open_but_requires_new_design.name: optimized exact MXFP4 x Q8_0 CUDA kernel plus source/cache solution
still_open_but_requires_new_design.why_open: This is the only exact compute class matching CPU fallback semantics and the only bottleneck class with a 10 tok/s no-overhead ceiling.
hard_requirements_before_code: Define kernel arithmetic equivalent to CPU fallback Q8_0 activation semantics or a deterministic token-level equivalence test.
Define how source/cache pressure is solved; streaming all up/down on demand requires about 90.6 GiB/s and is not viable.
Show expected added overhead below 1642.887 ms after removing near-full decode up/down fallback.
Pass fixed-text top1 verifier before any strict cold France token-rate run.

still_open_but_requires_new_design.name: verified token-stable Blackwell native FP4 path plus source/cache solution
still_open_but_requires_new_design.why_open: It may offer fast compute, but it is approximate relative to CPU fallback and not currently wired into one-stream.
hard_requirements_before_code: Create a top1 verifier path before performance testing.
Prove the source/cache solution separately; compute speed alone cannot overcome the 18.69 GiB resident-payload and 90.6 GiB/s streaming bounds.
Reject immediately if fixed-text top1 differs or France output is semantically wrong/incomplete.

still_open_but_requires_new_design.name: new exact compressed resident representation
still_open_but_requires_new_design.why_open: Only a real footprint reduction, not layout-only packing, could make exact residency fit under 16GB/VRAM constraints.
hard_requirements_before_code: Specify compression ratio and decompression overhead.
Show resident footprint below the current budget while preserving accepted gate-cache benefit.

next_recommended_step.name: write kernel/source design for optimized exact MXFP4 x Q8_0 or reject it on paper
next_recommended_step.why: All cheaper existing-path candidates are now closed. The only remaining path with a 10 tok/s ceiling requires new exact compute plus a source/cache solution.
next_recommended_step.minimum_artifact_before_code: A design artifact with arithmetic mapping, memory/source plan, overhead estimate, verifier command, and rejection thresholds.
